_comment: Copy to config.json next to server.py and restart the web-search MCP (projects/tools/restart_svc.ps1 -Name websearch). Without config.json the server uses 'builtin'.

_providers.builtin: no key needed - Wikipedia + DuckDuckGo Instant Answer only, not a general web search
_providers.brave: Brave Search API (free tier available). Easiest: put the key in C:\LLM\secrets\brave-search.key and keep provider 'builtin' - it switches to Brave automatically
_providers.tavily: Tavily API key (built for LLM use)
_providers.searxng: your own SearXNG instance: set url instead of api_key
